newsitem.title: USA: Triton wins Italian exploration acreage.
newsitem.headline: Triton wins Italian exploration acreage.

text.p: Triton Energy said Thursday that it has been awarded participation rights in three contiguous exploration permit areas in the Southern Appenines region of Italy.
Triton will have a 50 percent interest and will be operator of all three blocks, which together cover 40,741 hectares (100,673 acres) in the center of the southern coast of Italy.

The other shareholders, which each hold 25 percent interest in blocks Fosso del Lupo, Masseria di Sole and Valsinni are Canada Northwest Italiana and Union Texas Petroleum Holdings Italian subsidiary, Union Texas Adriatic Inc.
Triton has a 40 percent interest in two offshore exploration blocks off Italy's southern coast, with Enterprise Oil the operator and owner of the other 50 pct.
Triton is best know for its participation in the Colombian discoveries, Cusiana and Cupiagua, the largest Western Hemisphere oil finds since Alaska's Prudhoe Bay.
